queueNameOrArn.title: Queue Name
queueNameOrArn.description: The SQS Queue name or ARN

accessKey.title: Access Key
accessKey.description: The access key obtained from AWS.

secretKey.title: Secret Key
secretKey.description: The secret key obtained from AWS.

autoCreateQueue.title: Autocreate Queue
autoCreateQueue.description: Setting the autocreation of the SQS queue.

amazonAWSHost.title: AWS Host
amazonAWSHost.description: The hostname of the Amazon AWS cloud.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: The underlying protocol used to communicate with SQS

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.title: Default Credentials Provider
useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the SQS client should expect to load credentials through a default credentials provider or to expect static credentials to be passed in.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.title: Profile Credentials Provider
useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the SQS client should expect to load credentials through a profile credentials provider.

useSessionCredentials.title: Session Credentials
useSessionCredentials.description: Set whether the SQS client should expect to use Session Credentials. This is useful in situation in which the user needs to assume a IAM role for doing operations in SQS.

profileCredentialsName.title: Profile Credentials Name
profileCredentialsName.description: If using a profile credentials provider this parameter sets the profile name.

sessionToken.title: Session Token
sessionToken.description: Amazon AWS Session Token used when the user needs to assume a IAM role.

uriEndpointOverride.title: Overwrite Endpoint URI
uriEndpointOverride.description: The overriding endpoint URI. To use this option, you must also select the `overrideEndpoint` option.

overrideEndpoint.title: Endpoint Overwrite
overrideEndpoint.description: Select this option to override the endpoint URI. To use this option, you must also provide a URI for the `uriEndpointOverride` option.
